There are material contradictions and omissions in the testimonies of the prosecution witnesses.
This appeal is of the year 2015 and there is no possibility of early hearing of the appeal in near future.
State on the other hand has opposed the application for suspension of sentence and supported the impugned judgment of conviction and sentence passed by the trial Court.
